item.title: Important notice for Iranian Ceno users
item.description:
We deliver a daily package of independent international media to Iran via TV satellite. During a shutdown, Ceno users can open the 'Free Media Websites' below when using Public Mode.
Note: requests made in Public Mode are visible on the BitTorrent network.
